This is the classic rotation signature: leadership changes hands while credit stays loose, so it should be read as rotation, not a top. The divergence itself is the risk to watch — if lending standards flip while Mag7 keeps sliding, rotation converts to rollover.

But bank lending standards read 0% on SLOOS (deep in LOOSE territory, far from the ~40% stress threshold), HY OAS is 3.24%, and SPY is +0.61% over 1 month — none of the credit plumbing that confirms a rollover is flashing.
